sleeve-2x2x3.title: Drawer sleeve 2x2x3
sleeve-2x2x3.blurb: Crate shell with an open front: same feet, lip and clip sockets as a crate, so sleeves stack into a cabinet and take a crate or a cap on top. Holds one drawer.
sleeve-2x2x3.print_notes: Upright on its feet, no supports. The lintel over the opening bridges 79.5 mm: print a bridge test first and keep part cooling at 100% for bridges. 3 walls, 15% infill. Optional 6x2 mm magnets.

drawer-2x2x3.title: Drawer 2x2x3
drawer-2x2x3.blurb: Drawer for the 2x2x3 sleeve, inside 75.6 x 79.4 x 11.0 mm, divider slots every 21 mm, label recess and finger cup on the front. Slides out 54 mm to a stop; lift the front to take it out.
drawer-2x2x3.material: PETG (the detent tongues flex) or PLA
drawer-2x2x3.print_notes: Upright on its floor, no supports: the groove under the floor bridges 7.6 mm, the finger cup grows at 45 deg. 4 walls (the walls are 1.6 mm), 15% infill.

rail-x-drawer-2x2x3.title: X rail for drawer 2x2x3
rail-x-drawer-2x2x3.blurb: Divider rail sized for the 2x2x3 drawer, 9.0 mm tall, notched from below; goes in after the Y rail. Same profile as the crate rails.
rail-x-drawer-2x2x3.print_notes: Flat on the bed (the thick-end side up), no supports, 100% infill.

rail-y-drawer-2x2x3.title: Y rail for drawer 2x2x3
rail-y-drawer-2x2x3.blurb: Divider rail sized for the 2x2x3 drawer, 9.0 mm tall, notched from the top; goes in first. Same profile as the crate rails.
rail-y-drawer-2x2x3.print_notes: Flat on the bed (the thick-end side up), no supports, 100% infill.
